items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: He went with the New Yorkers, and then he wanted me to go with the New Yorkers and play, back on the saxophone.

ctx.x: call transcriptions and he was big wheel and power down at the Victor and he had four or five radio shows, so he was -- you know, he would be the guy for a guy like Farrar to go with. And he did.

So what's his name took -- he didn't take Itzy Itzy Riscoll -- he didn't know what Itzy was going to do. Let's see, who else -- Chauncey, well he could have used Chauncey too. He went with the New Yorkers, and then he wanted me to go with the New Yorkers and play, back on the saxophone.
Had you played at all in these years?
